scientific_integrity: The continuous Langevin model and symmetric splitting framework are credited to the cited literature. All claims concern the newly specified exact-subflow scheme; numerical checks are subordinate to a written proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-dimensional quadratic target, exact normal and rotation subflows; sharp squared synchronous coupling exponent rather than exact W2 or L2 mixing gap; no higher-dimensional, nonlinear, finite-precision or computational-cost claim.
title: Sharp anisotropy-uniform contraction of a reversible Gaussian rotation--OU Strang sampler
